title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: schc_fragmentation.json format_version mismatch
description: Pre-existing issue discovered during review of commit 3658d1d. The test 'shared_vectors_drive_production_implementations' in rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:146 asserts `document.format_version == 1` but test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json has `format_version: 2`. All other test vectors are at format_version 2 as well. Fix: update the assertion to expect 2.
